title: Curry Deviled Eggs with Parsley
summary: Steamed hard-cooked eggs are halved and the yolks mashed with mayonnaise, parsley, lemon, mustard powder, curry powder and cayenne, then piped back and topped with parsley leaves.
equipment: medium saucepan with a lid and steamer basket

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Mash
steps.text: Mash the yolks smooth with the mayonnaise.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Mix in the parsley, lemon, mustard powder, curry and cayenne.

steps.title: Pipe
steps.text: Pipe into the whites and top with parsley leaves.

tips: Steaming makes the eggs easier to peel.
Bloom extra curry powder in a little warm oil for deeper flavour.
Fill no more than a few hours before serving.
storage: Refrigerate covered and eat within 2 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
